title: Police Blotter: 26 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Twenty-six people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Nov. 22, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges — DWI, family-violence assault, organized retail theft, drug possession and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Twenty-six people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Sunday, November 22, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge or hold shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Calvin Thomas Amerson

Amerson was arrested on Sunday, November 22, 2026, at 12:23 a.m. on two counts of possession of marijuana, less than two ounces, each a Class B misdemeanor, and driving with an invalid license with a previous conviction, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set on any charge at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.
